title: Will my child need to end Speech Therapy at a certain age?
metaTitle: Duration of Speech Therapy with Age | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Get answers about whether there's an age limit for Speech Therapy for children with autism at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe in focusing on each child's unique journey rather than setting age as a determinant. The duration of Speech Therapy is not defined by your child's age, but by their individual needs and progress. Some children may require support into their teenage years and beyond. Rest assured, we are here to walk this path with you and your child, every step of the way.
